about.title: About
about.metaDescription: Boston Milal Korean Church is a Korean Presbyterian (KAPC) church in Chelmsford, Massachusetts, in Greater Boston. We belong to the New England Presbytery.
about.intro: Boston Milal Korean Church is a Korean Presbyterian church in Chelmsford, Massachusetts. Milal means a grain of wheat.
about.motto: Serve one another as good stewards (1 Peter 4:10)
about.pastorBio: He studied theology at Chongshin University, then M.Div. and Th.M. at Gordon-Conwell. He previously served as pastor of Lebanon Korean Presbyterian Church.
about.identity: We are a Korean Presbyterian church in Chelmsford. We worship in Korean in Greater Boston.
about.congregationAlt: Church members gathered outdoors in front of the building

koreanSchool.title: Korean School
koreanSchool.metaDescription: Korean School meets on Sundays at Boston Milal, a Korean church in Chelmsford, MA. Children learn Korean language and culture at 15 Alpha Road.
koreanSchool.intro: Sunday classes in Korean language and culture for children, at our church in Chelmsford.
koreanSchool.goals: Kids learn Korean, and they get used to being at church.
koreanSchool.time: Sundays, 9:30-10:30 AM, in the spring and fall.
koreanSchool.contact: Classes meet at 15 Alpha Road, Chelmsford, MA 01824. Ask after worship if you have questions.
